description: Find local businesses and their contact details from Google Maps: name, address, phone, website, rating, and the email address published on the business website where there is one. Use this for requests like "find 200 dentists in Austin with their emails", "get me restaurants in Berlin with phone numbers" or "build a list of plumbers near Manchester". This is the best starting point for local business prospecting. Costs $12 per 1,000 records from a prepaid balance; you are refunded for anything not delivered. Returns a job id, not the data: poll job_status, then call download.

categories.description: Optional extra category filter, comma separated.

email_verification.description: Verify every email in real time for an extra $5 per 1,000. Default false.

language.description: Google Maps interface language, e.g. "en", "de", "tr". Default "en".

list_name.description: Name for the export file. Defaults to a name built from the search.

location.description: Where to search. A city, region or country. Example: "Austin, Texas".

min_rating.description: Only include places at or above this Google rating.

search_terms.description: What kind of business, comma separated. Example: "dentist" or "dentist, orthodontist".

skip_closed.description: Skip permanently closed places. Default false.

total_records.description: Maximum records to collect. Multiple of 100, minimum 100, maximum 50000. This is a ceiling, not a promise.

name: google_maps_leads
title: Find business leads on Google Maps
